summary: One blocking finding is valid and should be repaired by making the upgrade-required path set and checkedPaths comparison semantics explicit.

items.title: Upgrade-required source set is not concrete enough for gate validation
items.rationale: The current spec names src/skills and src/presets but leaves generic upgrade source inputs open-ended, so gate implementation and tests cannot determine the required evidence set consistently.
items.evidence: requirements[2].desc says generic template/config sources read by upgrade without enumerating them; src/upgrade.js imports deploySkills from src/lib/skills.js, deployPresetCopies from src/lib/preset-deploy.js, validatePresetChain from src/lib/presets.js, and mergeAgentDefaults from src/lib/agent-defaults.js. requirements[3].desc also says checkedPaths covers current upgrade-required changes without defining whether checkedPaths stores changed file paths, roots, or patterns.
